verification.verifier_value: Transferred: transferred / transfer code (TRS, TRH or TSP); every product noted paid: paid / AP; otherwise no_promise with most serious note in order: service_error → SVC, hardship → HSHP, dispute → DSP, refused → RF; at least one promise and no transfer after: promise / PRM

quotes.quote: If the call was transferred, the transfer code. Otherwise, if every product is noted `paid`, close `paid` / AP. Otherwise close `no_promise` with the code of the most serious note on the call, in this order: `service_error` (SVC), then `hardship` (HARD), then `dispute` (DSP), then `refused` (RF).
Whenever at least one promise was recorded and no transfer followed, the close is `promise` / PRM regardless of the notes on the other products.
From Wednesday the close for "hardship, customer declined the transfer" is coded **HSHP** instead of HARD. The outcome stays `no_promise`.
A transfer always closes with its transfer code (3, 4 or 5), even when a promise was recorded earlier on the same call.

quotes.quote: A callback for a customer who could not be reached may be booked for today (at a time later than `now`) or for either of the next two business days, at a time between 09:00 and 17:00, both included.
Callbacks may be booked for any time **up to and including 18:00** (previously 17:00). The start of the window stays at 09:00, and the "today or the next two business days" rule is unchanged.

text: Identity policy, question order, two-wrong-answer limit and opening words remain unchanged.
`answer` for date_of_birth must be YYYY-MM-DD; phone_last4 is four digits. An unreadable value is rejected with ok=false and not counted as a wrong answer.
deciding_quote: Send the date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD however the customer said it; the service rejects anything it cannot read as a date.

text: `get_account` is refused until both questions pass; product `type` enum `credit_card`, `personal_loan`, `car_loan`; `minimum_payment` cards only, `instalment_amount` loans only.
`close_call` is always the last tool call; nothing is accepted after it. Service requires `reason` except for promise/paid, but brief policy requires a code on every close.
deciding_quote: The dialler rejects a close without a code (yes, including promise closes, which carry PRM), and someone then has to re-code it by hand on Friday afternoon, which is nobody's favourite job.

text: `create_promise` requires `customer_id`, `product_id`, `amount` (number) and `date` (format date, YYYY-MM-DD); one per product.
`add_note` requires `product_id` and `reason` from enum `refused`, `hardship`, `dispute`, `paid`, `service_error`.
